segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the revised order for the facilities team: 42 user seats, asset tracking module, and the standard support plan, starting September 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That lines up. My main thing is invoice timing. We need the first invoice dated after August 20, otherwise it lands in the wrong budget month.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I can set the billing start to September 1 and note invoice issuance no earlier than August 21. Annual prepay is $31,920 before tax, based on the pricing sheet we reviewed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the go-live date is still October 7? We have calibration reports due that week, so if setup drifts, it's a problem.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: October 7 is still the target. The kickoff would be September 5, data import by September 18, and admin training the week of September 23. That gives us about two weeks of buffer before go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. We also need three admin seats included in the 42, not extra. Last quote had that right, I just want to say it out loud.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, three admins and 39 standard users, all included in the 42. No separate admin fee.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Contract term is 12 months? Our legal team asked whether there’s an auto-renewal.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Twelve months, September 1 through August 31 next year. It renews for another year unless either side gives 45 days’ notice. If you prefer 60 days, I can put that version in the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Forty-five is fine. Please send the order form today and copy Marcus in purchasing. If he’s good, I can sign tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the order form with the September 1 start, August 21 invoice note, 42 seats, and October 7 go-live. You’ll have it in your inbox by 2:00 Eastern.
